description:
Create a new custom quadratic performance curve in eQUEST named 'HighEff_DX_PLR' representing a high-efficiency DX cooling unit part-load profile. 

Curve Definitions:
- Name: HighEff_DX_PLR
- Type: Quadratic (function of one variable)
- Coefficients: Constant=0.085, x=0.250, x^2=0.665

Assign this new curve to the 'Cooling EIR-f(PLR)' parameter for all five Ground Floor (G.*) Packaged Single-Zone (PSZ) HVAC systems:
- Sys1 (PSZ) (G.S1)
- Sys1 (PSZ) (G.E2)
- Sys1 (PSZ) (G.N3)
- Sys1 (PSZ) (G.W4)
- Sys1 (PSZ) (G.C5)

Finally, run the annual DOE-2.2 simulation and save the project.
